_description: icecream (icecc) distributed-compile node: a generous process limit and a TCP health check on the daemon port.
_comment_net: PAIR THIS WITH HOST NETWORKING (the default). iceccd and the scheduler find each other by LAN broadcast (node 10245, scheduler 8765/8766), which a private netns does not carry.
_comment_arch: icecream ships the build client's toolchain to the node, so the node needs no matching compiler installed - but client and node must share a CPU architecture. A weak box makes a better scheduler (icecc-scheduler) than a node.
_comment_rlimits: Compiles fork heavily; give a generous process limit. The base config already sets a 1M RLIMIT_NOFILE, so don't re-add that. /tmp is a RAM tmpfs and iceccd uses it for scratch - size it if your builds are large.

_registry.notes: Node daemon (iceccd). Point clients at the scheduler, not at this node. `icecc-scheduler` belongs on one host only.
